summary: A fire at Shakti Components Pvt Ltd (SUP-1008) in Pune has halted production on Line 2 for an expected 48 hours. Two purchase orders for Bracket 501 (PO-1001 and PO-1002) totaling 6500 units and INR 491400.00 are affected. Current inventory provides only 1.5 days of coverage, leading to shortages for both orders. The biggest unknown is when the supplier will actually restart production.
